Package neqsim.process.engineering.scd

Class ScdDesignModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.scd.ScdDesignModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ScdDesignModel extends Object implements Serializable
Revision-bound System Control Diagram projection of the shared P&ID and simulation bindings.

Template and terminal assignments are explicit project inputs. The selected legacy standard is a drawing basis, not a claim that the complete template behaviour or safety lifecycle has been implemented. This class never installs controllers, changes a process or turns a proposed signal into an executed runtime connection.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim development team

    • ScdDesignModel

      public ScdDesignModel(EngineeringProject project, PidDesignModel pid, PidSimulationBindings bindings, String drawingNumber, EngineeringStandard standard)
      Captures a source-linked drawing model after checking the project-controlled standard edition.
      Parameters:
      project - source engineering project
      pid - shared P&ID model
      bindings - shared explicit runtime bindings
      drawingNumber - controlled SCD drawing number
      standard - selected NORSOK I-005:2013 or legacy IEC PAS 63131:2017 reference
